segments.oily: One reviewer with oily, acne-prone skin found the ingredients well-suited to her skin type and liked how her skin looked after each use.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or very dry skin are split: some find it gentle enough to use regularly without stripping their skin, while others with really dry skin found it left their face tight and better suited to occasional rather than daily use.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin found it gentle yet effective at cleansing her oilier T-zone without any tightening.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including some with rosacea or flaky, red skin, mostly describe it as calming and non-irritating, though one reviewer cautions it may bother very sensitive skin.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the wash cleans without stripping or tightening their skin, leaving it soft and hydrated; however, two reviewers with really dry skin found it left their face a bit tight and warn the clay and alcohol in the formula can be drying if you don't have excess oil to begin with, making it better as an occasional scrub than a daily cleanser for them.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with rosacea reports the wash didn't trigger any redness, and another with red, inflamed, irritated skin says the oats calm and soothe that reaction rather than burning like harsher cleansers do.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports the wash cleaned thoroughly without leaving her skin feeling squeaky or as if her moisture barrier had been stripped.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several who are acne-prone, report no new breakouts and some describe fewer breakouts or clearer skin over time; one reviewer, however, didn't notice any improvement in her existing acne, saying the cleanser seems more geared toward soothing and hydration than treating breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: A couple of reviewers with oily or T-zone-prone skin say the clay in the formula pulls out excess oil and dirt effectively, though the same clay is noted as the reason it can feel drying for those without excess oil.

aspects.libelle: Very mild exfoliation, barely noticeable scrub
Soft, creamy lather that rinses clean
Exfoliating bits can get into eyes and hairline
A little product goes a long way

extraits.titre: Overly gentle, very few exfoliating beads
extraits.texte: It’s an extremely gentle exfoliant. If you’re looking to really feel the scrub get something else.

After using this oat exfoliator, I found it to be creamy with soft oat bits in them that felt calming and gentle on my skin. I have been using this pretty often to gently exfoliate my skin and I have to say, it definitely is very mild. some parts of my face (especially around my jawline) seems to be less clogged and my skin little a tad bit brighter but this was very subtle. I didn't find my skin to feel tight after using this cleanser and it didn't cause my skin to breakout so it works for my sensitive skin. Other than that, I don't feel like my skin is more hydrated or anything like that.

extraits.titre: Not really for dry skin, but I like it anyway!
extraits.texte: Even those of us with dry, sensitive skin need to exfoliate occasionally, so I ordered this Oat Exfoliating Facial Polish Cleanser by Purito Seoul in the hopes that it would be gentle enough for me to use. It arrives in a box with a security seal, and inside is the tube of product with a foil seal under the cap. I set about to use it immediately, and was pleased to discover that this face wash is about as gentle as an exfoliating wash can be, yay! It has no added fragrance and really does not smell like much of anything, which is fine by me. The formulation contains four different mild surfactants, and they produce a soft and bouncy foam that simply feels lovely on the skin. The exfoliation part comes from oat kernel flour, so it is not hard particles, just some mild abrasion from the soft kernels. The wash rinses easily, and I was surprised to see that my skin did not feel squeaky clean from oils being stripped. To reiterate, it left my skin feeling very clean, but I did not feel as if it damaged the moisture barrier at all. I also love that the wash did not exacerbate my rosacea; after rinsing my skin looked healthy, and did not become reddened at all. The reason I say that this might not be the best product for dry skin is because in addition to the exfoliating kernels, it also contains two kinds of clay and denatured alcohol. I love this cleanser from Purito Seoul because of how gentle it is. As someone who has super sensitive, dry, and flakey skin, I find that this cleanser is perfect for me. I always struggle with finding the perfect cleanser for my skin type because the red, inflamed parts of my face burn when I use cleansers that use harsh chemicals. Luckily, one of the top ingredients of this cleanser is oats, and oats work extremely well for calming dry, red, and irritated skin. The oats in the face wash are not fully ground into a paste. Some oat bits make this face wash to be considered an exfoliating face wash, but because the exfoliating bits are pieces of grounded up oats, it makes it gentle enough to be used as a daily cleanser that won't strip your skin of all its natural oils and over exfoliate your face to cause it to be senstiive. After using this face wash for a while, my pores have become less noticeable, and the overall health of my skin has significantly improved as well. I have a natural glow on my skin that I used to never have before. I'm super happy to report that this face wash didn't clog my pores and caused me to break out, and that it has quickly become my new favorite face wash because of how well it works for my skin type.

extraits.titre: Gentle scrub but not as hydrating as I’d like
extraits.texte: If you’re looking for a quality cleanser or facial scrub with a great list of wholesome ingredients this might be it. But if you have really dry skin this might leave you a little tight so it may not work as your daily. For me personally it’s not moisturizing enough for me to use as a routine cleanser but it’ll work fantastic as a weekly exfoliating scrub. While it didn’t leave me “dry” my skin felt a little tight and I know my skin and that bit of tightness is something I really have to avoid. Please keep in mind that I have *really* dry skin and unless I use very specific products my face will not only tighten but will flake and peel shortly afterwards. So I have to be very selective in what I use. Although I can’t replace my cleanser with this, this is the 1st exfoliating scrub I’ve found that I can even use. And I have to say, after polishing I used my milky toner and moisturizer to rehydrate and wow my face was smooth and clean! So I’ll have to use this infrequently but it’ll be perfect to help with my post retinol peeling or my winter flakiness.

Super gentle on my combo skin yet pretty exfoliating and definitely skin loving, also kind of feel like soothing. One big thing I really love about this cleanser that it’s truly cleansing, especially my pores in problem tzone, where all the oils and dirt likes to hang out. Use it alone or 2 step system it’s truly fantastic hydration and no skin tightening feeling here! Super happy with quality!

extraits.titre: It is ideal for oily skin
extraits.texte: I loved this product because I have oily skin and acne-prone skin, and when you use it its texture is soft and feels like it has bits of oatmeal in it, it cleans deeply and above all its ingredients are very favorable for my skin type, I love it, I use it twice a week and I love how my skin looks after using it.
